analytics.disabled_reason: No endpoint host exists yet. The site is static files on GitHub Pages, which cannot receive a POST, so a counter that reported a number without a sink behind it would be an invented number on a page that promises every value is sourced. The client is shipped (assets/analytics.js) and is completely inert until an endpoint is configured here and in the same commit the footer sentence changes.
enable_procedure: 1. Deploy the endpoint source in analytics/ to a host you control (analytics/endpoint.php for any PHP host, analytics/worker.js for Cloudflare Workers). The source is not deployed by this repository.
2. Set analytics.enabled to true and analytics.endpoint to the absolute https:// URL of that endpoint.
3. Rebuild and deploy. The footer cookie/privacy paragraph is generated from this block, so it changes in the same commit and cannot go stale.
4. Confirm one request arrives, then confirm the sink's stored rows contain no IP address, no user agent and no reader identifier.
never_recorded: cookie or any persistent reader identifier
order value or anything about what the reader bought
analytics.policy_basis: Amazon Program Policies section 3(e) requires an accurate statement of cookie and third-party technology use on an Associate site, and section 3(s) forbids artificially generating clicks. The counter therefore fires only on a reader-initiated click (event.isTrusted) and never on load, on scroll alone or from a synthetic event.
